name: Waaree Energies Ltd
title: Waaree Energies Ltd - 544277 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 but Q4 margin fell to ~18.6% on commodity, freight and mix; FY27 operating EBITDA guided to Rs7,000-7,700 crore on 10 GW cell ramp, with capex of ~Rs30,000 crore raising supply risk.

capex.peers_comment: Management said industry module capacity is hard to pin down and some lower-efficiency oversupply exists, but it does not see oversupply in high-efficiency modules.
capex.quote: There could be oversupply in the lower efficiency modules, but that's not where Waaree plays.

triggers.label: Cash conversion ~27% on inventory build
triggers.quote: the cash flow operations percentage has significantly come down

triggers.label: Capex ~Rs30,000 crore planned
triggers.quote: We have planned a capex of approximately INR30,000 crores across verticals

triggers.label: Commodity-led price pass-through started
triggers.quote: customers have started factoring the increased price in the new commodity levels already

triggers.label: FY27 operating EBITDA Rs7,000-7,700 crore
triggers.quote: guiding for operating EBITDA of INR7,000 crores to INR7,700 crores for financial year 27

triggers.label: Order book ~Rs53,000 crore, up from Rs47,000 crore
triggers.quote: Our order book continues to remain robust to approximately INR53,000 crores

guidance.quote: guiding for operating EBITDA of INR7,000 crores to INR7,700 crores for financial year 27
The safe assumption could be to assume 80%-85%utilization on the full year scale for FY'28 on the cell capacity.
the safest assumption there will be is your 19 %-20% margin consistent for a decade long at least

prior_guidance_check.quote: our reported total EBITDA of INR 6,617 crores has surpassed our guidance range

red_flags.label: Cash conversion ~27% vs EBITDA
red_flags.quote: the cash flow operations percentage has significantly come down

red_flags.label: Q4 margin compression
red_flags.quote: There was limited movement of ships inbound as well as outbound

evasions.quote: We will soon also be laying out the request for approval from the shareholders for raising this capital up to INR10,000 odd crores.

evasions.topic: BESS unit economics and FY29 revenue
evasions.quote: too early to comment on any guidance around the revenue in FY29 for this
Very difficult to answer with government also not able to answer so far.
